edits.replacement: Published a self-audit: 919 project documents reviewed; all 141 dated findings, including earlier overstatements, are in a public finding register linked from the README.

Screen-capture findings: 100% evasion in tested Windows 10/11 and macOS 14-26 laboratory configurations. Simulated proctoring, not commercial products; Linux untested. macOS 26 tests used native capture tools rather than browser getDisplayMedia().
Coordinated disclosure: Disclosed to MSRC (Feb 2026) and Apple (Mar 2026); both later classified the behavior as by-design/documented, not a security issue. Windows/macOS PoC source is now public.

40-question pilot: 34 answerable questions and 6 refusal cases; Recall@5 = 0.941, mean citation_support = 0.978, 6/6 refusals. One automated judge scored no answer below citation_support < 0.5; two flagged rows scored 0.75 and 0.50. This is not a hallucination-free guarantee.

Mehr Guard: Kotlin Multiplatform offline URL analysis; 25+ heuristics and 19 red-team cases. Repository-reported 87% F1 on curated URLs and sub-5ms desktop-JVM engine median exclude camera/UI and unmeasured platforms.

Systems work: SentinelSSH, Rust MCP with 17 typed read-only Linux inspection tools and no shell; SentinelFlow, C++17 IDS reporting 28.4M packets/s in a synthetic parser-only benchmark, not full IDS throughput; Zurvan, public Python/Rust MCP knowledge engine. Its 20 Oct 2026 receipt: 3,334 passed, 1 failed, 8 skipped; Z1b closure open.

Led security/backend work: WebAuthn passkeys, TOTP MFA, Postgres RLS and audit logging in a shared Next.js/TypeScript student platform. The 17 Aug 2026 CI test job passed 1,343 tests in 155 files; the separate security job failed, so an overall CI pass is not claimed.
